paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "Attention Weights" on the vertical axis and "Exp. Length" on the horizontal axis, illustrates the attention weights assigned by the LaSQuE model for different explanation lengths ranging from 5 to 35, with the horizontal axis marked at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Attention Weights," is scaled linearly from 0.20 to 0.45, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. Five blue bars represent the attention weights for explanation lengths of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35, respectively. The bar for explanation length 5 has an attention weight of approximately 0.38; the bar for 10 has a weight of approximately 0.41; the bar for 15 has a weight of approximately 0.41; the bar for 20 has a weight of approximately 0.36; the bar for 25 has a weight of approximately 0.32; the bar for 30 has a weight of approximately 0.34; and the bar for 35 has a weight of approximately 0.35. The bars are arranged in ascending order of explanation length along the horizontal axis, and there is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
